text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-ops-017","cls":"operator"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate for OER screen"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291"},"comment":"init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"routine crystallization step per SOP (label: standard_anneal_400C)"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":10,"y":10},"comment":"locate sample spot"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"24 h stability"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"FTO-2291"},"comment":"update surrogate"}]}
